scope: operator analysis only; no repeated end-to-end performance benchmark or accuracy scoring; no device-side timing instrumentation

longbench.selection: fixed seeded length-stratified sample; identical IDs and prompts for every method

execution.input_overflow: identical head-tail truncation preserving prompt formatting; record original/effective tokens
execution.representative_selection: short/median/long input batches per dataset; frozen IDs before comparing methods
execution.warmup: matching shapes before timed capture; warmup/JIT captured separately
execution.scheduler_note: client concurrency is not guaranteed resident GPU batch size; record active sequences, prefill/decode mixture, preemption and queueing

profiling.unit: batches of up to 8 requests; final partial batch explicitly marked
profiling.capture: prefill plus fixed 128-token generation; traces aligned to scheduler steps where available
profiling.nsight_compute: not required; GPU counters currently restricted by RmProfilingAdminOnly=1
profiling.trace_storage: gzip traces, immediate parsing and summaries; monitor free space and stop visibly before exhaustion

outputs: raw CUDA kernel timelines and CPU/runtime events
kernel busy-time union separately from cumulative kernel-time sum
ranked optimization candidates with evidence and identifiability limitations
interpretation: profiled eager timings are diagnostic and not a replacement for existing production throughput measurements
fused read/dequant/attention remains one measured category
kernel memory operations do not expose standalone completed physical KV read/write times
K4V4 and K4V2 have different storage budgets; report actual layout/metadata/tail overhead
stage classification must be supported by scheduler/range evidence; mixed steps remain mixed, not arbitrarily split
